facts.value: firmware: a webserver on an ESP32 (or ESP8266) that drives LED strips
up to 3 outputs per ESP8266, up to 10 per ESP32
Access Point and station mode, with an automatic failsafe AP

facts.note: WLED listens for DDP packets on port 4048 and does not read the optional timecodes in the header.
Up to 9 adjacent universes; no more than 3 universes (510 LEDs) for a smooth 25 ms (40 fps) frame rate.
Multiple RGB is the default: 3 channels per LED.

facts.value: E1.31 priority is set in the UI; higher-priority senders override lower ones with a 3 s timeout; senders of the same priority are not merged (no HTP).

setup.en: For DDP, give the out-bridge a ddp route to the WLED's address: { "match": "light/*", "sink": "ddp", "host": "192.168.1.50", "port": 4048, "pixels": 60 }; light/<i>/r|g|b, 0..1, is pixel i from 0.
setup.zh: 用 DDP 時，在輸出橋接程式設一條指向 WLED 位址的 ddp 路由：{ "match": "light/*", "sink": "ddp", "host": "192.168.1.50", "port": 4048, "pixels": 60 }。light/<i>/r|g|b 是 0..1，i 是從 0 起算的燈珠。

setup.en: For Art-Net or E1.31 instead, switch WLED to that mode in its Sync settings and reboot it once, then send through the out-bridge's artnet or sacn sink.
setup.zh: 要改用 Art-Net 或 E1.31，在 WLED 的 Sync 設定切到那個模式，重開一次，再經輸出橋接程式的 artnet 或 sacn sink 送出。

problems.en: WLED goes back to its own effect about 2.5 s after the last DDP packet, on top of the bridge's watchdog: a page that stops sending loses the strip.
problems.zh: 最後一個 DDP 封包之後約 2.5 秒，WLED 會回到自己的效果，這是在橋接程式的看門狗之外的另一道保險：網頁停止送出，燈條就不再聽它的。

problems.en: Two senders at the same E1.31 priority are not merged: one page and a lighting desk on one strip fight.
problems.zh: 同一個 E1.31 優先權的兩個來源不會合併：一個網頁和一台燈控台送同一條燈條會互搶。

use.en: Page values go to the out-bridge, whose ddp sink packs light/<i>/r|g|b into DDP for the strip, at most 60 times a second, with a watchdog.
use.zh: 網頁的值送到輸出橋接程式，它的 ddp sink 把 light/<i>/r|g|b 打包成 DDP 送給燈條，每秒最多 60 次，附看門狗。

use.en: Patched as RGB fixtures, the strip takes the DMX engine's looks through the out-bridge's artnet (or sacn) sink, with the flash cap.
use.zh: 把燈條 patch 成 RGB 燈具，它就經輸出橋接程式的 artnet（或 sacn）sink 接收 DMX 引擎的燈光，附閃爍上限。
